question: BACE1 inhibitors in early Alzheimer disease: efficacy evidence from randomized controlled trials (SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA, not real publications)

screening_brief.include: Randomized controlled trials of BACE1 inhibitors in patients with early Alzheimer disease, published 2015-2026, English.
screening_brief.exclude: Narrative reviews, observational designs, in-vitro-only studies without clinical population, publications before 2015.

output_contract.notes: result.json must mirror every declared field.

records.title: LX-2201, an oral BACE1 inhibitor, in early Alzheimer disease: a 24-month randomized trial
records.abstract: In a 24-month randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial, the oral BACE1 inhibitor LX-2201 reduced brain amyloid burden by 61 percent in patients with early Alzheimer disease, though cognitive decline was not significantly slowed.
